summary: State read/modify wrapper: reads an array-state value, delegates once with a mode argument of 2, re-reads the array-state value, delegates a second time passing the first read value with a mode argument of 0, then returns the second read value. The two reads bracket a state-setting call that uses a fixed mode.

operations.description: v2 = ArrayStateRead(this): read the current array state via 0x004D47E0.
Delegation_47c0(this, 0, 2): delegate to 0x004D47C0 with a fixed mode of 2 and argument 0.
v3 = ArrayStateRead(this): re-read the array state via 0x004D47E0 after the delegation.
Delegation_47c0(this, v2, 0): delegate to 0x004D47C0 again, passing the earlier read value v2 with a mode of 0.
Return v3, the array state re-read after the second delegation.

unresolved: Meaning of the Delegation_47c0 mode arguments 0 and 2 (likely an enum) is not established here.
